title: Lesson 3 - Sales and Marketing Processes End to End
description: Given a scenario, discuss common sales and marketing processes and anticipate key implementation considerations.

questions.question: Which statement about campaign influence is correct in a standard Sales Cloud org?
options: Campaign influence restricts opportunity access to campaign members
Customizable Campaign Influence attributes opportunity revenue across multiple campaigns using a model and time window you configure
Campaign members can only ever be Leads
A parent campaign disables member statuses on the child campaigns
questions.explanation: Customizable Campaign Influence applies an attribution model and time window so several campaigns share credit, while influence governs attribution rather than access and member status picklists still apply to the hierarchy.

questions.question: An admin enables Enterprise Territory Management so opportunity access follows the account's territory. How does that access combine with the role hierarchy?
options: Territory-based sharing grants access in addition to the role hierarchy and does not remove existing access
It deletes the role hierarchy and replaces it entirely
It only affects account records and never opportunities
It requires the Sales Engagement license for every user
questions.explanation: ETM layers territory-based access on top of the existing sharing model, so it adds visibility via territory assignment rules rather than replacing the role hierarchy or restricting anyone.

questions.question: A rep has qualified a deal and wants to send a formal quote. What must be in place on the Opportunity?
options: A scheduled report subscription on the opportunity
Einstein Activity Capture enabled for the rep
An active territory model that includes the account
Products added from a price book so a Quote can be generated and synced
questions.explanation: Quoting starts from the opportunity's products on a price book, and the generated Quote syncs its lines back to the opportunity, so the other options do not enable quoting.
